modules.module_title: Operate and maintain the card punching machine

pcs.pc_description: identify specific commercial software under the guidance of the jacquard designer for jacquard card punching in accordance with the industry standards and specifications
select the relevant option from the software menu for setup and operation of card punching
number the cards serially according to the jacquard design
insert the card in the punching machine one after the another
keep the punched cards serially in order
store the punched cards in clean and dry place
ensure the machine works in a proper condition by suitably lubricating and cleaning

modules.module_title: Lace the punched cards together according to the design

pcs.pc_description: lace the punched cards according to the serial number using needle and twine thread manually or in a lacing machine
use lacing hooks to hold the punched cards together in a lace for a particular jacquard design
select the type of lacing hook according to the length of the card to be punched
assort all the punched cards and handover to the jacquard weaver for weaving
